name: First User End-to-End Validation

blocking_defects.summary: Structured Analysis fails before the LLM call because production schema_migrations records version 008 as applied while the table and index defined by the current 008_action_plan_snapshots.sql are absent. The full read-only schema audit found no other missing migration-defined objects.

usability_findings.summary: Registration UI does not expose username/password validation rules and reduces structured HTTP 422 validation details to a generic HTTP 422 message.

notes: A01 account registration/session flow passed after using a username that conforms to the existing canonical server validation contract.
A02 passed after the user explicitly saved an OpenAI-compatible provider configuration and the connection test succeeded.
A03 passed: the first user successfully created and selected a Person, a Relationship scoped to that Person, and a Conversation scoped to that Person.
A04 passed: four real Message records were explicitly added to the selected Conversation and remained present after refresh.
A05 passed: the first user confirmed the selected Person Timeline rendered the expected real evidence without reporting cross-person contamination or duplicate-on-refresh behavior.
The first A06 attempt displayed Failed to fetch because the local SSH tunnel had terminated; that attempt was an environment interruption rather than a product failure.

After the tunnel was restored, A06 returned HTTP 500. Server traceback identified sqlite3.OperationalError: no such table: action_plan_snapshots while constructing learning-strategy context before the provider call.

Read-only production schema audit confirmed migration versions 001 through 013 are all recorded, SQLite integrity_check is ok, foreign_key_check is clean, and only the table and index defined by 008_action_plan_snapshots.sql are missing.

Production remained on TEST-155 handover HEAD 9fad72ca9ef6f1721d22c458a61d97619261b4d1 with a clean working tree, service MainPID 585381 and NRestarts 0, and protected port 8899 remained owned by PID 52822 during the audit.

Git history shows the current 008_action_plan_snapshots.sql was introduced after production had already recorded migration version 008, establishing a migration-version collision as the root cause. Existing historical migration 008 must not be edited or deleted.
Runtime readiness currently validates migration-version parity but not required schema objects, so this drift remained falsely ready.
No database repair has been executed yet. Repair should be additive and controlled, preferably through a new migration version rather than altering the historical 008 ledger entry.
No username, password, API key, real name, relationship detail, private chat content, or conversation identifier is recorded in this UAT artifact.
Real relationship and chat content must remain in the production database and must not be committed to GitHub.
Phase A remains blocked at A06 until schema drift is repaired and Structured Analysis is rerun successfully.
Phase B is longitudinal and should use genuine real-world events rather than synthetic completion.
